'''Mike Fitzgerald Another ROps deck with a different title''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Mike Fitzgerald]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6926">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6926 Another ROps deck with a different title], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 20 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6926/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6926/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018165521/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6926/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike Fitzgerald]]
* '''Published:''' 20 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Another ROps deck with a different title''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Arrest Order|Endor-D-imperialarrestorder.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor ROps Fitzgerald DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck uses ROps like other ROps deck. I'm sure everyone has played ROps so this shouldn't be new.

The post names no Defensive Shields.

== Original post ==

'''Another ROps deck with a different title'''
* '''Author:''' Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald
* '''Published:''' May 20, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck uses ROps like other ROps deck. I'm sure everyone has played ROps so this shouldn't be new.

=== Strategy ===

Not sure what to say , pretty standard stuff. Always start Imperial Arrest Order and get your AT-ST Pilots out on the AT-STs for quick battle destinies . Revo might be a problem and if it is then you should switch a few things around for Crush the Rebellion and Evaders ( BDControls , a Trample , the Barrier , maybe a grappler ).
